summary: Frontend-only testing of Iter75 in-modal forgot/reset password flow (LoginModal.jsx). Verified full state machine login -> forgot -> forgot-sent -> reset -> login stays inside the SAME modal with no navigation, plus real end-to-end password reset with a live 8-digit code from Mongo, login with the new password, state reset on modal close/reopen, and admin login regression. All 11 requested checks passed. coach@test.com password was restored to Coach2025! and login with the original password re-verified (HTTP 200).

issues: Button label renders as 'RESTABLECER CONTRASE A' - the 'Ñ' glyph is missing in the PLANE_CRASH display font (same artifact visible in 'INGRESA TU CONTRASEÑA' label). Cosmetic, pre-existing font issue, not introduced by this change.
Shows placeholder 'Imagen no configurada' because home-settings.auth_login_image_url is empty in this environment (CMS data, not a code bug).

action_items: Optional: fix missing 'Ñ' glyph in PLANE_CRASH font usage (or fallback font) for labels/buttons containing Ñ.
Optional: configure auth_login_image_url in CMS so the modal's right image column is not a placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginModal.jsx resets forgot/reset state on close but keeps `email`/`password` (email intentionally, password cleared on goForgot) - behavior is correct and verified.
All views expose data-testid attributes; no missing testids found.

success_rate.backend: N/A (not in scope; forgot/reset endpoints returned 200 during flow)

seed_data_creation: One password_resets code generated+used for coach@test.com; a second generated+used to restore the original password. No pending codes left, no other data created.
test_credentials: admin@futuresoccercup.com / FSCAdmin2025! (unchanged); coach@test.com / Coach2025! (restored and verified)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter75 in-modal forgot/reset flow fully verified via Playwright: nav-link-ingreso -> login-modal-form -> login-modal-forgot (URL unchanged, modal stays open, email carried) -> forgot-back-to-login -> login-modal-forgot-submit -> login-modal-forgot-sent -> login-modal-go-reset / login-modal-have-code -> login-modal-reset-form -> reset submit -> back to login-modal-form with email prefilled + success toast. Escape closes modal and state resets to login view. Admin login redirects to /admin. Reset codes are readable via motor query on db.password_resets (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME in backend/.env).
